In Eclipse Che versions 7.61.0 through 7.124.0 three related defects in the SCM-OAuth flow, chain into a Medium-severity finding: 1. Open redirect (CWE-601) — `EmbeddedOAuthAPI.callback()` and the OAuth1 callback issue `307 Temporary Redirect` to whatever URL was carried in the `redirect_after_login` field of the OAuth `state` parameter. The value is fully attacker-controlled and never compared against an allow-list of permitted hosts. 2. Missing CSRF nonce in OAuth `state` (CWE-352) — `OAuthAuthenticator.prepareState()` builds the `state` parameter solely by URL-encoding the original request's query string. No random nonce is bound to the user's session, so an attacker can pre-compute a callback URL carrying _their own_ SCM authorization `code` and have a logged-in victim open it. `callback()` then stores the attacker's SCM token under the victim's Che identity (`personalAccessTokenManager.store(...)`). 3. Mutable field on a `@Singleton` (CWE-362 / CWE-488) — `EmbeddedOAuthAPI` is `@Singleton` but stores the per-request `redirect_after_login` value into the instance field `private String redirectAfterLogin`. Any user's `authenticate()` call overwrites the field for all concurrent users; the `access_denied` error-path of `callback()` then redirects to the _last writer's_ URL. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Gravedad 4.0 8.30 Gravedad 4.0 txt HIGH Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis
